summary.text: Mark Johnson was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2018 and sworn in in January 2019; he represents District 17, which includes Conway, Mayflower, parts of Faulkner County and parts of northwest Pulaski County.

paragraphs.text: A native of Crossett who grew up in Conway, he graduated from Conway High School and Hendrix College.

He worked on the staff of Congressman Wilbur Mills, for the Small Business Administration and the City of North Little Rock, served in the cabinet of Governor Frank White, and later became an advisor to businesses, cities and organizations on fundraising.

sources.title: Biography of The Honorable Mark Johnson, Arkansas State Senator
